record.label: Spacetime cost at most 369,800 on 100 qubits
record.statement: The paper reports $3{,}698$ $T$ gates on 100 qubits for the final circuit, giving a spacetime cost of $369{,}800$.
record.boundary: Lean bounds the compiled primitive $T$ count by the symbolic list total. Multiplying that upper bound by the total width of 100 qubits gives a spacetime cost of at most $369{,}800$.
